  Case No.:             2016                       17-10-2024                       30-10-2024
                                     Report:                     Resolution:

   Location:            Santiago         Region:    Metropolitana   Classification:     Explained

                 An abnormal aerial sighting was reported at
Summary:
                24:00 hours on 21 August 2024 from the commune of Providencia.

The reported information described objects, practically circular, associated with a large cluster of clouds at the height of a nearby building to the reporter. This person added that it seemed to him that the clouds were slightly behind or below the first object, which for a moment he thought was a reflector, but he did not see a beam of light. Then a second object appeared, which approached.

At the second, then three more. He thought they would collide. He interpreted the movements as coordinated and intelligent, with some sort of connection between them, where the first one, "which didn't move more than slightly," apparently commanded the rest.

The case featured the recording of the file "20240822_002538.mp4" and the photographs "20240822_002914.jpg" and "20240822_002924.jpg".

The user's location was georeferenced at coordinates 33° 25’ 27’’
S, 70° 35’ 44’’ W and 508 m.s.n.m.
The forensic examination of the footage confirmed its digital integrity and determined that
It was captured using a Samsung brand mobile phone, model Galaxy A12
(SM-A127M) from 00:30 (HL) on Thursday, August 22, 2024. It was seen
It analyzed by studying each one of its 9,470 frames. Moreover, the two

The photographs were captured with the same equipment at an interval of nine seconds from 00:29 (HL).

Investigation:

Figure 1 shows four of the objects studied as they appear at the beginning of the recording. As can be seen, the sky was overcast with clouds that obscured the celestial bodies.

The astronomical survey confirmed that the Moon was at 41.5° of apparent elevation and at an azimuth of 51°.

The examination of the aerial situation upon indicating the filming of the case evidenced that there were no aircraft over the city
                                    Figure 1

According to meteorological observations made from Arturo Merino Benítez Airport, upon capturing the images, winds were blowing from southeast to south with intensities declining from 7 to 4 knots (11.3 to 6.4 km/h), horizontal visibility at surface level was at least 10 km, and there was no cloud cover.

Partial cloud formation at around 1,830 meters altitude, but above that, the cloudiness at 3,000 meters varied to partial.

In the following hours, the sky cleared from the southwest, so the clouds tended to gather towards the northeast of Santiago, which was consistent with the testimony and with the image in Figure 2. The central building next to the Moon is the one that appears illuminated in blue in the frame of Figure 1.

Figure 2

Figure 3

The geometric analysis of the frames confirmed that the objects under study were not reflections caused by the camera. Figure 3 illustrates this with frames 5 and 574: if they had been caused by parasitic light, the celestial projections would have connected the objects in the green circles to some light source.

The following Figure 4b shows the result of applying an edge detection algorithm to the objects in frame 251 shown in Figure.

4a. Unlike the smooth but defined edges of the solid elements indicated with yellow arrows, the boundaries of the silhouettes of the objects studied result with diffuse textures, only slightly more granular than the resulting pattern of the background. This pointed to them not necessarily being solid.

Figure 4

Furthermore, in Figure 5, the same procedure was applied to frame 87, where the lighting of an air signaling device was visible.

Present in the roof of a nearby building.

                                       Figure 5

The processed edges of its silhouette, from a very defined white line, result
completely opposite to the object studied, but similar to those of two
windows of rooms illuminated from the inside. Derived from this, it can be
considered that the studied object does not have the characteristics of a solid
volume emitting light.

The frames that form the recording of the case were captured

automatically at a rate of 30 per second, which under normal conditions
prevents seeing sudden movements. For better definition, a frame rate of 60
per second would have been better.

Considering the poor lighting conditions and the capture speed, special care
was taken to analyze the direction of the translation of the reported objects and
the optical aberrations present, visible as apparent streaks following their
movements. Thus, it was determined that

The indicated within a green rectangle in Figure 6 (6351) was a beam of light that was visible upon touching the surface of clouds, which disappeared upon crossing a sector of clear sky. (Figure 6)
While, very faintly, it could be seen beyond frame 6417, so that its pivoting coincided with the formation of two bright objects in a sector with clouds, similar to those previously present in the scene. In the
As shown in Figure 11, the beam is marked with a blue dashed line, at

the two objects associated with green circles and one previous with a red circle.

                                       Figure 7

From all of the above, it was derived to consider the reported luminous objects
as refracted lights in the cloudiness. The cloud background and below, the
scene that was clear, was illuminated from behind by the Moon, which was located
in the southeast and at about 50° above the horizon. Thus, the conditions were
generated for the light beams to pass

Unobserved, so the witness only saw what appeared to be flying discs or "balls" in the sky.

This type of flash show can consist of one or more light spots, associated with clouds, with apparently circular or oval silhouettes, which may eventually change color. Their movements come from the movement of the lights that originate them, which on the surfaces they refract can be perceived as rapid flights, eventually with

periodic rotations and swayings, which together can be interpreted as
intelligent behaviors
According to what was published by the media outlet InfoBae
(https://www.infobae.com/mexico/2023/08/24/la-verdad-sobre-las-luces-que-
They were seen in the sky of CDMX before Taylor Swift's concerts on February 24th.
August 2023, people who were in Mexico City
They witnessed and filmed lights in the sky that seemed to move and create patterns.
among the clouds, which on social media were considered UFOs and which are

Similar to what was studied. Later confirmations identified them as evidence of lights from a series of concerts held in the following days.

As seen in a frame from one of those videos (Figure 8), the scene was very similar to this case and no light beams were visible.

Figure 8. Lights in the sky near Pantitlán, Mexico City. Extracted from Twitter/@ALBAALCAZAR/@MarcosOlivos5/@EnriqueMontalvo

According to the analysis of the testimony and the results of the geographical, forensic, meteorological, astronomical, photographic, and air traffic studies

Conclusion:

it was concluded that what was reported was the projection of lights onto a cloud background.
